components.name: EMA-Nesterov lookahead buffer (EMA of per-step displacement)
Tail EMA of weights (τ=150, fp32, eval-only readout)

aux_note: AdamW m and v on embedding and LM head, bias-correction-free Adam m and v on 1-D params, plus EMA-Nesterov prev_params and lookahead buffer on all of them; the tail EMA also covers the LM head and 1-D params (≈0.50 of A, embedding excluded)
notes: RowFloor and CWD keep no persistent buffers: the per-row floor factors and the cautious mask 1[U·W>0] are per-step locals, and SOAP's extra lam_row/lam_col vectors (unused, SOAP_KL=0) are O(rows+cols). The fp32 tail EMA (README launch TAILEMA_TAU=150, START 2400) is only blended into a stashed copy for val_ema_loss; the other ~40 env levers (LAWA, schedule-free, PSGD, MUON_SNR and the rest) are off and allocate nothing.
evidence: should_soap_param: return is_mlp_fc or is_mlp_proj or is_attn_proj or is_qkv (all hidden)
SOAP params: state["exp_avg_sq"] = torch.zeros_like(p, dtype=torch.float32); state["row_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(0), p.size(0)); state["col_gg"] = torch.zeros(p.size(1), p.size(1))
soap_update_preconditioner: q_row/q_col = soap_eigenbasis(...) on first call, then soap_basis_qr every step (SOAP_PRECONDITION_FREQUENCY = 1) replacing q_row, q_col, exp_avg_sq
optimizer1 = AdamW([embed.weight], [proj.weight], fused=True); optimizer3 = Adam(1-D groups): state["exp_avg"] = zeros_like(p), state["exp_avg_sq"] = zeros_like(p, fp32)
Muon.step also allocates state["lam_row"] = torch.ones(p.size(0)), state["lam_col"] = torch.ones(p.size(1)) (vectors, read only if SOAP_KL)

_tailema = [None if p is model.embed.weight else p.detach().float().clone() for p in model.parameters()] when TAILEMA_START <= step+1 < TAILEMA_END, then _tailema[j].add_(p - _tailema[j], alpha=1/TAILEMA_TAU)
ROWFLOOR branch: r_row, s_row, f_row, u2 are locals; CWD: _cwd_mask = (update.float() * p.float() > 0) local, applied via p.mul_ after rescale_to_radius
